_comment: OpenClaw REITs Expert System - Configuration Template. Replace ${HOME} with the absolute path to your home directory before use, OR use this as a reference and run install.sh / install.ps1 to apply settings via 'openclaw config set'.

list._comment: Master agent - the only entrypoint. Routes all incoming messages and dispatches sub-agents.
Energy assets: wind, solar, hydro, gas-fired, district heating, storage.
Utilities: water, sewage, gas, district heating, waste-to-energy.
Transport & logistics: highway, rail transit, ports, logistics warehousing (high-standard / cold-chain).
Industrial / commercial property: industrial parks, IDC, mall, community retail, office, hotel.
Affordable rental housing & long-term rental apartments.
Holding-period monitoring, KPI dashboards, red/yellow/blue risk warnings.
Transaction structuring, credit enhancement, tax planning, expansion / exit paths.
Market intelligence, regulatory tracking, comparable transaction database.
ESG assessment, climate risk quantification, carbon accounting, green finance certification.
Document drafting, cross-agent data integration, format compliance.

bindings._comment: Unified entrypoint - all messages route to the master agent, which dispatches sub-agents internally.

alternative_routing_by_keyword._comment: Optional: route directly to a sub-agent when the message contains specific keywords. Uncomment and adapt as needed.
